verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms launching Copilot cloud agent tasks from GitHub itself (docs-8, docs-15, docs-18: 'Launch work from GitHub', automations triggered by repository events, partner agent apps in GitHub workflows), but there is no evidence of triggering agents from GitLab, Linear, or Slack. Missing for 10: documented GitLab integration, Linear integration, Slack integration for kicking off agent tasks, and any independent confirmation of these cross-platform triggers.
